item.title: Agentic Compositional Multimodal Natural Language 3D Model Search
item.description: Building an agentic multimodal search system (CoI-Fit) for 3D product retrieval at Bucketplace, combining LLM reasoning with BM25+KNN hybrid search across visual, textual, and spatial signals via LangGraph and A2A protocol.
